summary.name: Blave
summary.one_liner: Blave is a free, open-source Mac and Windows quant workspace that lets you build, backtest and trade strategies with Claude Code or Codex.
use_cases: Backtesting trading strategies with an AI agent
Combining several strategies into one portfolio
Finding strategy ideas from web pages
Running automated live trades on a connected exchange
summary.what_it_does: Blave is a desktop app for Mac and Windows that works with an AI agent (Claude Code or Codex) to turn ideas into backtestable trading strategies. The AI can open several web pages and convert them into strategy ideas. Strategies are checked for overfitting with three tests: MCPT, a Parameter Scan and OOS. Multiple strategies can be combined into one portfolio using a walk-forward backtest that re-weights daily and is compared against 1,000 random weightings. The app then shows the amounts and positions to hold, and you can either place the trades yourself or connect an exchange for automatic execution. The page lists public market data, bring-your-own data sources and the source code under Apache-2.0.
notable: Runs with Claude Code or Codex as the AI agent
Overfitting checks: MCPT, Parameter Scan and OOS
Walk-forward portfolio backtest compared against 1,000 random weightings
Source code public on GitHub under Apache-2.0
caveats: Windows installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows shows a protected-PC warning on first run
First launch takes a few minutes to set up its runtime
Automatic live trading requires connecting an exchange
